bullets.text: In Tiruttani, a gang broke into a house and hacked a girl's father to death because he rejected a love proposal, and the office should monitor law and order.
In Arambakkam in Thiruvallur, a woman attempted suicide with her children demanding the return of her second husband, and the district team should review family counseling support.
Four devotees suffered severe injuries when a statue collapsed inside the Tiruttani Murugan temple, and the administration must inspect temple structural safety immediately.
In the western suburbs like Porur, clogged canals have raised serious waterlogging concerns as the monsoon nears, and the office should coordinate urgent desilting works.
Residents of Officers Colony in Adambakkam are living in terror due to a growing stray dog pack, and the Greater Chennai Corporation must take immediate action.
The GCC has asked the NHAI to clear Cooum River obstructions for the Port-Maduravoyal project by October 15, and the department should track compliance.
The Tiruttani municipality announced a Rs 5,000 fine for dumping garbage in public places under its new solid waste management plan, and officials should monitor implementation.
Collector Kavitha announced November 15 as the last deadline for paddy crop insurance in Thiruvallur district, and local teams should assist farmers in meeting it.
Dark non-functioning streetlights on the Soothupakkam-Palavayal road in Senthil Nagar pose accident and theft risks, and the local body must restore lighting at once.
The Government of Keralam renamed its IT department to the Department of Information Technology, Artificial Intelligence and Digital, and our portfolio team should note this regional shift.
India's data center capacity is projected to grow significantly by 2030, creating high demand for diverse engineering roles, and the department should review state capacity building.
A Tamil Nadu ministerial delegation is visiting Kerala to meet Chief Minister V.D. Satheesan amidst by-election political calculations, and the office should track developments.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi will visit Chennai on October 11 to launch the Chennai Metro rail service and open the Ilaiyaraaja music learning center at IIT Madras.
